messages:
Maya: quick follow-up from last night's outage — we had intermittent 5xx/timeouts for hosted inference between 02:14–02:42 UTC; multiple customer endpoints impacted. postmortem tomorrow but we need immediate action items.
Jorge: copied timeline from logs, preliminary signal points to thrash between the batcher and kv-cache eviction when long sequences hit quant-fallback. attaching minimal logs in thread.
Li: I can reproduce a kernel-selection fallback loop locally — when the quantized path fails, runtime retries into a slower path which increases latency and triggers gateway retries.
Priya: short-term mitigation deployed at 03:10 UTC: ingress soft-rate limit + forced fallback to non-quant model for the most affected routes. 5xx volume dropped ~80% after that.
Support - Elena: impacted customers opened p1s: AcmeCorp (enterprise), Finly (mid-market), NoteFlow (startup). AcmeCorp asked for interim RCA and credits.
Sam: repro snippet I used locally:
```
# repro: long seq + concurrent streams
for i in range(200):
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-quant-1","input":"<very long prompt>"}' &
```

Li: will try same with kv-cache disabled to isolate eviction interaction.
Jorge: from tracing: `gateway -> retry loop -> backend 502 -> batcher backpressure`. kv-cache eviction count spikes at 02:17 and correlates with increased retries.
Maya: action items (owners + rough due):
- Disable aggressive quant-fallback heuristic in runtime (Li) — due: EOD today.
- Add short-term per-customer ingress quota to protect gateway (Priya) — due: today 18:00 UTC.
- Increase KV cache eviction logging and add gauge to dashboards (Jorge) — PR by tomorrow EOD.
- Customer communications + credits calc (Elena) — draft by EOD.
- Run extended repro harness across canaries (Sam) — results by tomorrow morning.
Priya: rollout tracked in rollout-123, can revert quickly if we see regressions.
Li: opening PR now referencing rollout-123 and adding a unit test for kernel-selection fallback path.
Maya: I'll own the postmortem doc and capture config diffs; please paste PR links here as you open them.
incident-bot: timeline posted: incident opened 4270000100, mitigations started 4270000660, partial restore 4270001000, full restore 4270001300.
Elena: customers notified with interim update; AcmeCorp requested a 1:1 — scheduling now.
Sam: FYI the repro harness shows a 2–3x increase in token-level retries during the failure window.
Jorge: canary with more conservative kv-cache eviction threshold reduced repro rate by ~60%.
Maya: good progress. capture all config deltas in the postmortem. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
